mild.definition: a. moderate in type or degree or effect or force; far from extreme
mild.translation:
a. 温和的, 温柔的, 淡味的, 适度的, 轻微的, (肥皂等)软性的
[医] 轻的, 缓和的

mild mercurous chloride ointment.translation: [医] 弱氯化亚汞软膏, 甘汞软膏

mild smallpox.translation: [医] 轻天花, 变形天花

mild-mannered.definition: s behaving in or having a mild or gentle manner
mild-mannered.translation: a. 温和的, 温柔的

milden.definition: v. t. To make mild, or milder.

mildening.translation:
v. (使)温和；(使)变暖和；(使)和缓
[网络] 变温和

milder.definition:
a moderate in type or degree or effect or force; far from extreme
s humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness
s mild and pleasant
milder.translation: a. 更暖；回暖；更温和（mild的比较级）

mildest.definition:
a. moderate in type or degree or effect or force; far from extreme
s. humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness
s. mild and pleasant
mildest.translation: a. 温柔的( mild的最高级 ); 温暖的; 轻微的; （味道） 不浓的

mildew.definition:
n. the process of becoming mildewed
n. a fungus that produces a superficial (usually white) growth on organic matter
mildew.translation:
n. 霉
vi. 发霉, 生霉
vt. 使发霉

mildewed.definition: v become moldy; spoil due to humidity
mildewed.translation: a. 发了霉的, 陈腐的, 长了霉花的

mildewing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Mildew
mildewing.translation: v. （使）发霉, （使）长霉( mildew的现在分词 )

mildews.definition:
n the process of becoming mildewed
n a fungus that produces a superficial (usually white) growth on organic matter
v become moldy; spoil due to humidity
mildews.translation: v. （使）发霉, （使）长霉( mildew的第三人称单数 )

mildly.translation: adv. 柔和地, 和善地, 适度地

mildmay.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 迈尔德梅绰号，迟钝的人，来源于中世纪英语，含义是“温顺的+少女”(tame,gentle+maiden); [地名] [加拿大] 米尔德梅

mildness.definition: n. good weather with comfortable temperatures

mildred.translation: n. 米尔德里德（女子名, 意为温柔、和善的）

mildred ella didrikson.translation: [网络] 米尔德里德埃拉迪德里克森

milds.definition:
plural of mild
a. moderate in type or degree or effect or force; far from extreme
milds.translation:
(mild 的复数) a. 温和的, 温柔的, 淡味的, 适度的, 轻微的, (肥皂等)软性的
[医] 轻的, 缓和的

mildura.translation: [地名] [澳大利亚] 米尔迪拉
